background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group AA-, S&P A after its upgrade on 15 Nov 2024 and Moody's A1, all stable. Leverage of 7.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, the only ratio held for it. The newest flagged item, on 21 Aug 2026, is a further round of job cuts; the others cover layoffs at their highest in a decade and a political debanking lawsuit, none of which bears on the group's credit.
